Done. Each command execution now writes two heap profile dumps to `/tmp/`:

- **`start`** — captured before the command runs
- **`end`** — captured after the command completes

Files are named like `/tmp/entire-pprof-20260319-143022-session_start-start.pb.gz`. You can analyze them with `go tool pprof <file>` or diff the two with `go tool pprof -diff_base=<start> <end>`.
